item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00186","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C05","C13","C24"],"selected_candidate_label":"C05","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C05 is expressly incorporated into the child by its date and supplies the concrete legal and administrative machinery for the appointment: it establishes the Operations Coordinating Board, authorizes the President to designate its chairman from among its members, and defines the Board's national-security coordination duties. The child then executes that authority by designating Gordon Gray chairman and assigning him duties under that directive. C13 is a weaker structural analogue for a short letter appointing an interagency committee chairman, while C24 supplies relevant biographical context about Gray but not the appointment machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I hereby designate you Chairman of the Operations Coordinating Board ... to perform duties in accordance with [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] dated February 25, 1957, as mended","parent_excerpt":"The Board shall have a chairman and a vice chairman, each of whom shall be designated by the President from among its members.","explanation":"The child directly invokes C05 and carries out its presidential-designation provision."},{"child_excerpt":"I reiterate the importance I attach to the Board's responsibilities.","parent_excerpt":"The Board shall ... advise with the agencies concerned as to ... the coordination of the interdepartmental aspects of the detailed operational plans ... [and] the timely and coordinated execution of such policy and plans","explanation":"C05 supplies the substantive responsibilities that the child assigns Gray to oversee."},{"child_excerpt":"your continuing responsibility as the principal supervisory officer of the work of the National Security Council","parent_excerpt":"there is hereby established within the structure of the National Security Council the Operations Coordinating Board ... which shall report to the National Security Council.","explanation":"The child's explanation of Gray's suitability tracks the institutional relationship created by C05."}]}
